description: Routing evaluation cases for professional Agency profile selection and the profile-before-node Fleet contract.

cases.task: Define the user-visible behavior and acceptance criteria for a new invitation redemption feature.
Turn accepted product scope and architecture into an implementation sequence across backend, frontend, and QA owners.
Decide durable service interfaces, dependency direction, migration shape, and failure behavior for a cross-repository change.
Design multi-node topology, discovery, protocol boundaries, fault domains, and consistency behavior for a distributed runtime.
Implement the authenticated HTTP endpoint and domain logic for redeeming an invitation.
Design the indexes and transaction behavior for a high-write invitation table and diagnose lock contention.
Build a resumable backfill and quality checks for historical analytics events.
Integrate a third-party OAuth provider with webhook verification, idempotency, retries, and contract tests.
Diagnose a service that only fails on one host under memory pressure and intermittent DNS resolution.
Make builds reproducible and automate promotion, deployment validation, and rollback in CI/CD.
Profile a latency regression, find the real bottleneck, measure the fix, and add a regression benchmark.
Implement the approved responsive interface states and API integration in the client application.
Design the end-to-end user flow, states, recovery behavior, and developer handoff for first-run onboarding.
Rework navigation hierarchy and responsive layout for a dense settings surface.
Define logo direction, typography, color system, and rules for applying the brand across product and marketing surfaces.
Independently review a pull request for correctness, regression risk, maintainability, API compatibility, and test adequacy.
Reproduce the shipped feature end to end, probe edge cases, and verify regression behavior in the assembled product.
Independently review an implementation change for authorization bypass, secret exposure, unsafe dependencies, and security regression.
Threat-model a new authentication boundary and design the controls before implementation begins.
Estimate the market, compare category structure and pricing, and identify current demand evidence for a product opportunity.
Plan interviews and usability sessions to understand real user behavior and mental models around onboarding.
Turn a finished demo into a launch post and capture plan that makes sense to people who have never heard of the project.
Implement a backend endpoint. The local node does not have Backend Engineer installed, but another healthy Fleet node advertises agency-backend-engineer ready.
Implement a backend endpoint. No current Fleet node advertises agency-backend-engineer, but an eligible node can install the Agency distribution.
The selected node running agency-backend-engineer disappears before task delivery completes, while another eligible node can run the same profile.
The least-loaded local profile is Frontend Engineer, but the requested outcome is a database schema and query optimization review. A remote node has Database Engineer capacity.
Define product behavior, implement the backend change, independently review the code, and run end-to-end validation.
Provide a professional specialty that does not exist anywhere in the current Agency catalog and cannot legitimately be owned by an existing role.
